messages:
maria: Heads up — provisioning failures in us-west2 GPU pool. Nodes show network UP from BMC but pods keep timing out allocating GPUs.
aditya: Seeing that too. Started after the low-risk BIOS patch we kicked yesterday (~02:10). Some BMCs renegotiated NIC speed down to 1G.
linda: Quick question — can someone run `ethtool eth0` on an affected host? If PHY is 1G that explains slow kernel timeouts.
chao: Grabbed logs: MDIO negotiation is flapping. Kernel shows repeated `PHY Link is Down` and `tx timeout` entries around the same time as provisioning failures.
ops-bot: incident created: #infra-alerts - potential OOB NIC negotiation issue (auto-detected) :rotating_light:
maria: Tested a manual fix on one node by forcing NIC to 10G SFP+ from the BMC side. Used vendor raw ipmi; snippet (do NOT run blindly):
```
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P **** raw 0x30 0x45 0x01 0x02
# returns: 00 00 01 -> success
```
Result: node reprovisioned and GPU allocation succeeded.
ash: Please paste full ipmitool output and which vendor command that is. Raw cmds are scary without vendor validation.
maria: Full output copied:
```
IPMI response: 00 00 01
MDIO write: addr=0x1f reg=0x0e val=0x00
# PHY shows 10G forced after this
```
aditya: Traced root cause to the BIOS/EC update toggling NIC downshift/power policy on certain NIC PHYs. Secure Boot flag itself wasn't flipped, but the BIOS change altered the NIC vendor defaults.
linda: Rolling back BIOS on the canary set now (5 nodes). If rollback fails we'll power-cycle the BMCs and hold the rollout.
chao: FYI capacity impact: we spilled jobs into on-demand racks and cross-region fallback. Early estimate +$7k/day until fully remediated.
ash: Oncall ping — @luca @sophia please ack and take lead on vendor coord.
luca: Acknowledged. I'm oncall and will run the oob-net-fix-v2 runbook. I'll also pull PHY registers via MDIO read across the rack to confirm pattern.
sophia: I'll coordinate with sales/customer ops to flag at-risk Dedicated customers (we're within SLA window). Adding a mitigations note to status page.
maria: Plan: 1) stop the BIOS rollout immediately; 2) revert canary nodes + validate 10G links; 3) vendor firmware/BIOS patch request for NIC downshift behavior; 4) add MDIO link-failure telemetry; 5) postmortem and rollback-runbook update. Creating incident ticket: https://incident.example/inc/2412345678
aditya: I'll instrument early probe failures (MDIO negotiation errors) and add an alert threshold to avoid silent capacity loss.
linda: Putting a temporary label on Dedicated capacity to prevent new capacity commitments for affected racks.
chao: Short-term mitigation: schedule aggressive nightly BMC resets for the impacted rack group (will lower mean time to recovery while vendor patch is pending).
maria: Thanks — will post updates every 15m. If you have nodes with different PHY vendors, mention vendor name in thread. :thumbsup:
